notes.title: UPDATE NUMBER ONE
notes.notes:
Hello, zomboDRIVERS! Thanks for your support!
Since the release into Early Access, we have released several updates, and here is what they included:

WHAT'S NEW

 Fixed a bug when the level was not loaded
 New spawn points for cars
 New objects in locations
 Fixed a lot of collisions
 Fixed walls on levels
 Some changes in interfaces
 Added game icon
 Added notification about the start of a new game
 Escape button now closes inventory
 The current time and weather will now be saved
 Changed the volume of some sounds
 Added support for widescreen monitors
 Removed bloom setting
 Removed unnecessary grass


Plans for the next updates in our roadmap:
https://trello.com/b/MyFwlIx6/zombodrive-roadmap
